title: A Structure-Preserving LOBPCG Algorithm for the Bethe-Salpeter Eigenvalue Problem
summary: The Bethe-Salpeter eigenvalue problem is a structured eigenvalue problem arising in many-body physics. In practice, a few of the smallest positive eigenvalues and the corresponding eigenvectors need to be computed. In principle, the LOBPCG algorithm can be applied to solve this eigenvalue problem. However, direct application of the existing LOBPCG algorithm does not utilize the inherent structure of the problem.
